title: cancel_collection
description: Cancels a job through qex (qex cancel when queued, qex kill when starting or running) and reports cancelled only after qex shows a terminal state. During import it lets the atomic import finish and says cancel-too-late. Preserves valid diagnostic artifacts.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous reply of the same query.

maxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte budget of the whole serialized reply (design section 4).
